What is Gahen Hawan?

Gahen Hawan is a powerful Vedic ritual conducted at Ashaeiynn Meditation Centre , Hisar. Designed for spiritual seekers, this sacred Hawan enables aspirants to engage in 24×7 Mantra Jaap remotely, ensuring uninterrupted spiritual growth.

Without consistent Mantra Jaap , removing negativity, Pitra Dosh , and activating the Third Eye is impossible. This Hawan serves as a bridge for those who wish to deepen their spiritual practice but are unable to perform daily rituals due to job or household responsibilities.
Who Should Participate?
This Hawan is perfect for:
✅ Individuals unable to perform daily Jaap due to work or household duties.
✅ Spiritual aspirants looking for intensive mantra practice .
✅ Those facing obstacles due to negativity & ancestral karmic blocks .
✅ Seekers on the path to Third Eye Activation .
Participation Requirements
To be eligible for this sacred Hawan, participants must adhere to the following:
Attend/Sit daily Hawan sessions for 11 days .
Join weekly Mantra Chanting Sessions .
This disciplined approach ensures maximum spiritual benefit and accelerates the removal of negativity/Pitra Dosh.
How It Works?
🌍 Online Zoom Sessions – Participate in the Hawan remotely.
🙏 Personal Sankalp – Your Sankalp (spiritual intent) is offered to Gurudev during the ritual.
🔥 Sacred Offerings – Your name is included in the offerings made during the Ram Naam Hawan.
Why Choose Ashaeiynn?
✅ 100% Authentic Rituals – Performed with ancient Vedic practices.
✅ Remote & Powerful – Conducted online, yet deeply effective.
